name: rubric-repair
description: Bounded admission loop: author -> blind rubric scoring of the committed artifact -> exactly one repair of the named findings -> frontier re-score -> second-disagreement STOP rule -> exactly one disposition. There is no loop engine, which is exactly why the loop is structural: the re-score hangs behind the repair, so a clean first pass cascade-prunes the whole repair arm instead of re-entering it. run_context seeds (ALL required): 'artifact_spec' = the one-line brief for the artifact to author; 'rubric' = the scoring-rubric text, applied verbatim by both scoring seats. Capability-class slot: the re-score pins model name 'council_a' - a CAPABILITY CLASS, not a vendor id. Bind it in your own config (plugins.entries.hermes-workflows.settings.models: {council_a: <your frontier model>}); an unbound class fails the launch closed BY NAME, never a silent downgrade. The other seats ride the seat default so an admission attempt is completable at no frontier spend. Blindness is structural, not phrased: the rubric seat consumes ONLY the author's artifact path (its inputs pick that one dotted path, so the author's claims never reach the scoring seat) and the re-score consumes ONLY the repaired artifact path plus the original findings list - never the repair's claim of resolution. Second-disagreement law: the first scoring pass counts as disagreement round 1; if the re-score seat still finds the artifact wanting after the one repair it sets disagreements: 2, which trips the halt machine gate (>= 2 halts, < 2 admits) - bounded admission, never an unbounded repair loop.

defaults.context:
You are one seat of a bounded admission loop. Ground rules:
- Open the artifact yourself from the path your inputs give you; no party's claims about it are evidence.
- Every claim you hand downstream names its evidence (file:line, or a quote from the artifact). Uncertainty raises a finding; only silence when nothing load-bearing is wrong.
- Reply with ONLY one fenced ```json block as your final message. Never print secrets.

artifact.description: absolute path of the written artifact

nodes.context: Blindness contract: you score an artifact, not an author. You were given the path and nothing else - no summary, no intentions, no self-assessment. Judge what is written, not what was meant.

artifact.description: absolute path of the repaired artifact

nodes.context: Blindness contract: you re-score an artifact, not a changelog. You hold the repaired path and the ORIGINAL findings list - never the repair's claims about what it fixed. Judge the file. Your class binding is the point of this seat: the second opinion must be at least as strong as the first.

disagreements.description: scoring rounds that found the artifact wanting: 1 (repair cleared it) or 2 (STOP)
